newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-GRADY TAKES ONE SHOT LEAD IN COOLUM CLASSIC.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-GRADY TAKES ONE SHOT LEAD IN COOLUM CLASSIC.

text.p: Former U.S. PGA champion Wayne Grady fired a six under par 66 to take a one shot lead in the first round of the Coolum Classic on Thursday.
Grady headed a quartet of fellow Australians -- Peter Lonard, Craig Parry, David Bransdon and Philip Chapman -- on the Coolum resort course in Queensland.
Play was interrupted briefly because of a thunderstorm and several players will have to return early Friday morning to complete their opening round.
Grady, who shot seven birdies and one bogey, played in the same group as his father under the tournament's pro-am format in the early rounds.
